source_reconstruction: A7 fixed-initial bounded path expansion permits initial-state averaging only with a defined stationary phase measure and justified measurability/integration.

A8 maps strict times to T-minus-reversed times, and initial phase to momentum reversal of the prescribed terminal phase. Fixed-time endpoint map is a finite composition of Borel measure-preserving affine flows and possibly discontinuous Borel reflection. Joint map is justified by fiberwise measure preservation plus Fubini.
Pathwise density balance follows integrating A4 on all finite arcs and reflection invariance, then A5 pairs incoming rates.

Apply finite-sector change of variables, nonnegative Tonelli and signed decomposition to bounded F(initial)G(terminal), yielding skew detailed balance; take F=1 and momentum-reversal invariance for stationarity.

Actual restart/Markovness is separately asserted in A1.p3 from exponential memorylessness and nonexplosion; it is needed for semigroup composition, not as a premise to finite prescribed endpoint reversal or fixed-time stationarity.

Alternative density/survival cocycle needs A4 producer; neither should be replaced by a tiny algebra wrapper.
endpoint_warning: Pointwise reversed right-continuous path equals R of forward left-limit at reversed internal event, not R of forward post-jump value. For endpoints and time integrals use strict prescribed times and AE-in-time equality; do not copy informal A8 into a false all-time equality.
